about: The launch film's captions: sound descriptions plus the on-screen kinetic lines, word for word. The single source for public/media/v1/film.en.vtt (website) and Pebble-launch-film.srt (LinkedIn). Written by lane E from docs/FILM_SPEC.md section 13; the frames follow tools/audio/beatmap.json (100 BPM, 18 frames per beat, 72 per bar, 30 fps). Both compositions (LaunchFilm 1920x1080 and LaunchFilmSquare 1080x1080) use the same timeline, so one track serves both.

conventions.start: first frame the caption is shown
conventions.end: first frame after the caption (exclusive); seconds = frame / 30
conventions.lines: 1 or 2 caption lines, shown together; a sound description is in square brackets and comes first
conventions.overlap: no two cues overlap, so the SRT needs no stacking
conventions.pace: every cue is shown for at least 1.2 s and at no more than 3 words per second
conventions.position: bottom (player default); every kinetic line on screen sits above the bottom 15 % of the frame, so captions never cover it
conventions.srt_time: HH:MM:SS,mmm, same rounding; SRT cue numbers count from 1 in this order
conventions.style: British spelling, sentence case, no exclamation marks; a kinetic line is copied exactly as it appears on screen, with its on-screen line break removed; whooshes and most clicks are not described (they carry no meaning the picture does not show)
conventions.chapters: film.chapters.vtt comes from src/content/chapters.ts (startSeconds), not from this file
